verdict_reason.value: The feed supports counts of candidate situations, recorded safe, out, and held outcomes, and person-ID joins to public sprint-speed and arm-strength leaderboards. It does not record the coach's sign, the runner's jump, or what a held runner would have done if sent. Base at contact is inferred from originBase.
